headline: US Chip Controls Risk Slowing Southeast Asia Data Center Expansion
summary: Investment bank Natixis warned that US restrictions on advanced chip technology could stall Southeast Asia's data center market due to regional infrastructure rented by Chinese AI players.
why: Southeast Asia has become a growth center for cloud infrastructure buildouts, which rely on access to advanced semiconductors and cross-border tech trade policy.

impacts.name: Data Center Industry
impacts.why: Trade controls targeting Chinese clients create tenant exposure risks for regional data center operators.
